summary.text: Mary Shea is the Democratic candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 29A, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, she said in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey that she has practiced law in Southeast Idaho for over two decades, specializing in child welfare.

paragraphs.text: Mary Shea earned a bachelor's degree from the College of William and Mary in 1987 and a law degree from the University of Richmond School of Law in 1990.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as attorney, small business owner and program coordinator for the Paralegal Studies Program at Idaho State University.
She has been affiliated with organizations including the Idaho State Bar, the American Bar Association and the Idaho Legal Aid Board.
Shea ran for the same District 29A seat in 2024 and lost the general election to incumbent Republican Dustin W. Manwaring, 55.2 percent to 44.8 percent.
In her 2024 survey responses, she listed strengthening public education, improving mental health resources and restoring civility in politics as her key messages.
